note: Seed queries per jurisdiction, tried in order until a corner lot passes the Census + zoning confirmation. Each is geocoded (cached) and an envelope of the county parcel fabric is scanned around it. Seeds lead with single-family residential intersections rather than the town's main commercial corner: the densest street grid in a small city is usually its downtown, and a commercial corner is the wrong specimen — FutureLot reports on residential lots, and the ADU setback question the front rule feeds is a residential one. Later seeds widen the search. The five unincorporated-county records are seeded at named unincorporated CDPs — territory outside any incorporated place, which is what makes the Census place lookup resolve to '<County> County (unincorporated)'.
